notes: Exact summaries and ships/AM/probe CSV parity: 20 Domination and 20 Annihilation battles, seeds 1-10 and mirrors.
Performance comparison uses seed 1 Domination, serial runs, profiler enabled. Correctness batches used parallel workers and are not latency baselines.
Game tests: same 1600x900 Vulkan Forward+ scene, Earth/Earth, seed 1, x4 autoplay, advance to 540s then 40 wall seconds. Fixed FPS was not used.
Baseline Debug pre-roll was slow; the 40-second sample only reached 554s. Compare 540-554s windows separately; it has no 600s FPS value.
All long game samples reproduced the pre-existing FleetAudio.Emit array-bound error: seven counters for an eight-value CombatSound enum. Not changed in this collision-only task.

Initial Debug pre-roll briefly overlapped setup/test compilation and a duplicate process that was stopped before frame sampling. Serial final profiles and all FPS samples ran without concurrent batch/validation jobs.
Release baseline game fixture uses the same exported engine/PCK/runtime and rebuilt baseline ExportRelease C# assembly; benchmark-info.json identifies it.
Whole seed-1 mean 0.272718ms and brawl p99 0.9978ms do not meet the original whole-project 0.2/0.6ms targets. Twenty-run pooled latency is not claimed.
Human manual-play smoothness and other-PC performance are unverified. No tick rate, catch-up budget, wreck collision lifetime, balance or AI changes.
Final source includes a collider lifetime XML comment added after the tested export; executable behavior is unchanged.
